test_arithmetic_expression_generation: test the arithmetic.arithmetic function generates valid expressions matching a target value
test_arithmetic_expression_length: test the arithmetic.arithmetic function produces expressions with a specified number of operations
create_arithmetic_expression: create an arithmetic expression string that evaluates to a given target integer or rational value
test_expression_length_constraint: test that generated arithmetic expressions respect a user-specified operation count
test_sympy_evaluation_correctness: test that sympy.sympify correctly evaluates generated arithmetic expressions to the target value
